notes.title: Late year update!
notes.notes:
It has been a busy year, although I was able to come back to a few games and make some fixes, thank you for being patient!

I have made a few changes:
[list]
[*] allow pausing and exiting game properly
[*] improved fps by fixing fog of war
[*] added a deep discoverable secondary garage
[*] random minor bug fixes
[/list]

More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Patch Update January 2nd, 2024
notes.notes:
Happy New Year Gamers!

Hope everyone had a great and safe holiday!  Coming out this year with a fresh update and a few new things added as well!

Keep the feedback coming and I will keep the updates rolling!

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Refined borders to not allow player to fall/glitch off ends or bottom
[*] Refined controls
[*] Fixed fog of war to better optimize fps
[*] Refined Sounds
[*] Fixed issues with panels randomly showing/hiding
[*] Fixed issue with random day resets and not allowing to move
[/list]

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated scaling
[*] Updated vehicle graphics and clipping when steering
[/list]

[b]New![/b]
[list]
[*] Added 4 drill upgrades to increase drilling speed.  The drill attachments are cheaper in long run than purchasing the upgrades.
[/list]

Added 2 new items:
[list]
[*] Vehicle move speed boost
[*] Teleport back to garage
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Update December 29th, 2023
notes.notes:
Hey gamers!

Apologies on the first release of this game, I have uploaded the incorrect build and uploaded a previous test/demo build.  I have since went back and patched some obvious errors and misses and updated to a new build and it is currently live.

Thank you all for the feedback, it is much needed and great for me and the game and the community!

Please let me know of any other bugs/errors/fixes for the future!

Split Rock Games

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed initial starting dig speed to be faster and scale faster
[*] Fixed dirt being added to inventory and taking up unnecessary space
[*] Fixed upgrade costs
[*] Improved vehicle movement and reduced clipping on blocks
[*] Fixed issue with upgrades not saving on purchase or between plays
[*] Fixed some GPU/CPU draw calls to optimize FPS
[*] Increased day length to make day feel longer
[*] Updated scaling on upgrade costs and upgrade values 
[/list]
